result.stdout:
Fabric.Mcp.Server 1.5.0

Description:
  Fabric MCP Server

Usage:
  fabmcp [command] [options]

Options:
  -?, -h, --help  Show help and usage information
  --version       Show version information

Examples:
  fabmcp storage account get --subscription "my-sub"
  fabmcp server start

CLI:
  tools          CLI tools operations - Commands for discovering and exploring the
                 functionality available in this CLI tool.

MCP:
  server         MCP Server operations - Commands for managing and interacting with the
                 MCP Server.

Azure Services:
  core           Microsoft Fabric Core Operations - Inspect capacities, discover, create,
                 and update workspaces, and search, create, and manage Fabric items. Use
                 this tool when you need to: - Get metadata for a known Fabric capacity -
                 List accessible Fabric capacities and their metadata - Search the
                 OneLake catalog to discover Fabric items across workspaces - Get
                 metadata for an existing Fabric workspace by ID - Get metadata for one
                 existing Fabric item by workspace ID and item ID - List accessible
                 workspaces and their management metadata, optionally filtered by the
                 caller's workspace roles - List item metadata within a known workspace
                 or folder, optionally filtered by type - Create new Fabric items
                 (Lakehouse, Notebook, etc.) - Track accepted long-running operations and
                 read their JSON or empty results - Create Fabric workspaces, optionally
                 assigning an existing capacity and domain - Rename a known workspace or
                 update or clear its description - Delete a known Fabric item, with
                 permanent deletion only by explicit opt-in - Delete an explicitly
                 identified workspace and the items under it - Manage core Fabric
                 workspace items - Submit workspace capacity assignments without waiting
        
[truncated]
